Name: Craftsman Player Home
Author: StirFryGingerBoy
Description:
This craftsman style home offers a unique feature to your Stardew Valley play through. 

Installation:
1. Go to the "Files" tab of the mod to download.
2. After downloading, navigate to your Stardew Valley Buildings folder Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Content\Buildings
3. Open the downloaded  rar file with winrar or other zip tool.
4. Move the houses.xnb file into your buildings folder and copy over the existing file (Remember to back up your files).
5. Play Stardew Valley
